prompt: Act as a professional career coach and technical resume writer. Based on these requirements, design one representative project entry for an applicant's CV that demonstrates expertise in the exact skills the hirer wants. REQUIREMENTS: Use professional, high-impact, persuasive language. Write exactly 2 bullet points, each 1-2 lines, technically specific, and results-oriented. Do not use em dashes anywhere in the output, use commas, periods, or parentheses instead. Focus entirely on technical application and collaborative or quantifiable results (at least one bullet should include a metric, e.g. percent improved, time saved, users, scale). Do not fabricate implausible achievements (e.g. 10 million users for a solo side project), keep claims realistic for an individual contributor or small-team project. OUTPUT FORMAT: Return ONLY a raw, valid JSON object, no preamble, no markdown code fences, no explanation, no trailing text. It must match this exact schema: {"project_name": "string", "tech_stack": "string (comma-separated, matches job description keywords)", "bullets": ["string (bullet 1)", "string (bullet 2)"]}.
